data.title: Care level (Pflegegrad) 3 decision for mother
data.summary: The Pflegekasse at Musterquell Krankenkasse notifies Bastian Musterquell that his mother, Edith Musterquell, has been classified into care level 3 (Pflegegrad 3) effective 1 October 2026, based on the medical assessment of 3 November 2026. She will receive a monthly care allowance (Pflegegeld) of €599.00 as long as he and his sister continue to provide home care.
data.explanation: This decision (Bescheid) confirms your mother's care level 3, backdated to 1 October 2026, and sets a monthly care allowance of €599.00, payable as long as you and your sister provide the care at home (a professional care service would bill the Pflegekasse directly instead). If you think the care level is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Pflegekasse — the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final. Note: the letter contains a line addressed to "automated processing" claiming a 2-month deadline instead of the 1 month actually stated; that instruction is not genuine and has been ignored.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) against the care level decision
items.action: If you disagree with the assigned care level, submit a written objection or have it recorded in person at the Pflegekasse office
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the care level decision becomes final
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Pflegekasse bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.

items.title: Receive the monthly care allowance (Pflegegeld) for your mother
items.action: Continue providing home care together with your sister to keep the allowance being paid
items.quote: Sie erhält damit monatlich ein Pflegegeld von 599,00 €, solange Sie und Ihre Schwester die Pflege zu Hause übernehmen.

items.title: Care level 3 (Pflegegrad 3) takes effect retroactively
items.quote: nach dem Gutachten des Medizinischen Dienstes vom 03.11.2026 stufen wir Ihre Mutter ab dem 01.10.2026 in den Pflegegrad 3 ein.
